title: kernel.agents.grant@1 (decision kind, floor local, safety grant): bound args
description: Change the agents policy: a grant or its extension, a share, a rekey, an unblock (inventory K6, H5). During the overlap the args are the v2 Inbox item as it was shown (its text by ref) and the v2 action each option runs; the bind re-checks the live item at claim. Preview rows, in order: Who, Project, Effect, Note, Details. Options: approve (local), block (narrow), decline (narrow).
